# 北约克租房指南：Finch地铁站、约大与华人合租（2026）

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/zh/blog/renting-in-north-york/
Language: Chinese (Simplified)
Updated: 2026-11-21

北约克租房住哪里？Finch地铁站附近、North York Centre、约克大学和 Seneca 周边各社区对比，北约克华人合租渠道与防骗要点，以及多伦多市的租房规定。

北约克租房，主要是 Yonge 街 Sheppard 到 Steeles 一段的高层 condo、老式出租公寓楼，以及独立屋里的单间和地下室。北约克 (North York) 属于多伦多市，1号线地铁直达市中心，适合约克大学 (York University) 和 Seneca 的学生、想住在华人或韩国社区附近的新移民，以及想要更大空间又不想放弃地铁通勤的上班族。住哪一片最合适，要看你每天坐哪条线、去哪个校区。

## 先看重点

- **condo 沿 Yonge 街分布**，从 Sheppard 一直到 Finch，Bayview Village 和 Don Mills 一带也较集中；单间和地下室在两侧的住宅街区。
- **1号线是主轴：** 4号线 Sheppard 往东，2025年12月开通的6号线 Finch West 往西。
- **Finch 站是交通枢纽：** TTC、YRT 和 GO 巴士在这里交汇，适合往返约克区的人。
- **约克大学 Keele 校区有两个地铁站；** 去 Seneca Newnham 校区要坐公交。
- **多伦多市的规定都适用：** 合租屋需要执照，翻新驱逐受市政府租赁翻新许可条例约束。
- **华人和韩国社区集中在 Yonge 街沿线**，讲普通话、粤语、韩语的房东很多。

## 北约克租房：房源类型

- **condo：** Yonge 街沿线（Sheppard-Yonge、North York Centre、Finch 站）、Bayview Village、Don Mills 与 Sheppard 一带，多为个人业主出租。
- **老式出租公寓楼：** 户型往往比新 condo 宽敞；2018年11月15日之前首次入住的单位受租金管制。
- **单间和地下室：** Willowdale、Newtonbrook、Don Valley Village 和约克大学周边的独立屋里很多。
- **学生合租屋：** 约大 Keele 校区附近常见一栋房子分别出租多个房间。

| 社区 | 适合人群 | 主要交通 | 注意事项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yonge 与 Finch (Newtonbrook、Willowdale) | 通勤族、华人和韩国社区 | Finch 站 (1号线)、公交总站 | 人多，地铁北延线施工 |
| North York Centre | 上班族、租 condo | North York Centre 站 (1号线) | condo 价格较高 |
| Yonge 与 Sheppard | 换乘方便 | Sheppard-Yonge 站 (1、4号线) | 车多、施工 |
| Bayview Village | 安静的 condo 生活 | Bayview 站 (4号线) | 便宜单间少 |
| Don Mills 与 Sheppard | Seneca Newnham 学生、爱逛街 | Don Mills 站 (4号线) | 去 Seneca 需坐公交 |
| 约克大学周边 | 约大学生 | York University、Pioneer Village 站 (1号线) | 无执照合租屋 |
| Downsview | 空间大、公园多 | Downsview Park、Sheppard West 站 (1号线) | 片区仍在改造 |

## Finch地铁站附近租房

Finch 站一带是北约克最热门的租房区域之一，尤其受新移民和需要往返约克区的人欢迎。Finch 站是 1号线 Yonge 支线的北端终点，也是大型公交总站，除了 TTC 公交，还有开往北边的 YRT 和 GO 巴士。Yonge 街两侧是 condo 和出租公寓楼，再往里走是大片独立屋，地下室和单间很多。

生活上非常方便：Yonge 街沿线中餐馆、韩国餐馆、面包店、超市和各类服务应有尽有。需要注意几点：

- **地铁北延线施工：** Yonge 地铁北延线正从 Finch 往北修，Yonge 街靠近 Steeles 一段会有施工路段。
- **高峰期拥挤：** Finch 站早晚高峰人很多，可以在你平时通勤的时段去看房，感受一下。
- **和房东同住：** 问清楚是否要和房东本人共用厨房或卫生间，如果是，《住宅租赁法》(RTA) 通常不适用。

如果也考虑住到多伦多市界以北，可以看[列治文山租房](/zh/blog/renting-in-richmond-hill/)，Yonge 街一路向北的选择都在里面。

## 约克大学和 Seneca 附近租房

约克大学 Keele 校区有 York University 和 Pioneer Village 两个 1号线地铁站。2025年12月7日开通的6号线 Finch West 在 Finch West 站与 1号线换乘，向西一直到 Humber College，Finch West 沿线也多了不少选择。

约大附近的房间多在校园周边和 1号线南段沿线的独立屋里，比如 Downsview 和 Sheppard West 一带。很多房子把多个房间分别租给学生，价格实惠、氛围热闹，但要注意：自2024年3月31日起，多伦多的多租户住宅 (multi-tenant house) 经营者必须取得市政府执照，并在入口处张贴。如果一栋房子分租很多房间、房东却拿不出执照，要多留个心眼。

Seneca 的 Newnham 校区位于 1750 Finch Avenue East，靠近404公路。学生常住在 4号线 Don Mills 站周边、Don Valley Village，或者 1号线 Finch 站附近，再坐 Finch 上的公交去学校。签约前，查一下你上下课时段的公交班次。想对比大多伦多各校区周边的社区，可以看[多伦多留学生住哪里](/zh/blog/best-toronto-neighbourhoods-for-students/)。

## 合租 condo 和老式出租楼的小贴士

北约克很多室友会合租 Yonge 街沿线的两房 condo，一人一间、共用客厅厨房。签约前要确认租约上写了所有租客的名字，或者至少清楚谁是主租客、谁是转租或分租，房租和押金的分担也要白纸黑字写下来。condo 大楼通常有自己的规章，搬家要预约货梯，访客停车和宠物也可能有限制。

如果租的是三层以上、十户以上的老式出租公寓楼，这类楼宇属于多伦多市 RentSafeTO 项目的监管范围。遇到维修问题，先书面通知房东；长时间得不到处理，可以拨打311向市政府反映。

如果租的是独立屋里的单间，记得问清楚整栋房子一共住几个人、几间卧室共用一个卫生间、厨房和洗衣机怎么排时间。人越多，越需要提前定好规矩。

## 北约克华人合租：渠道与防骗

在北约克找华人合租，大家最常用的是微信群、小红书、51.ca 和约克论坛，房源多、能用中文沟通，但每到开学季前，针对留学生和新移民的骗局也特别多：盗用真实 condo 照片、价格低得离谱、人"在外地"不能看房、催你先转定金。几条底线：

- **核实身份：** condo 要确认对方是业主本人或注册经纪人。
- **先看房：** 当面或实时视频看房，不接受"先付钱再看"。
- **先签约：** 使用安省标准租约，房东最多只能要求一个月租金的押金，不能强制预付几个月。
- **留凭证：** 所有付款走可追溯的方式，并保留收据和聊天记录。

更多识别技巧见[多伦多租房诈骗](/zh/blog/toronto-rental-scams/)。

## 按身份选北约克社区

- **约克大学学生：** Keele 校区周边或 1号线往南到 Downsview 一带通勤最短，合租屋记得确认执照。
- **Seneca Newnham 学生：** Don Mills 与 Sheppard 一带或 Don Valley Village，坐 Finch 上的公交或从 Don Mills 站转车。
- **去市中心上班：** Yonge 街上从 Sheppard-Yonge 到 Finch 的任何一个 1号线车站步行范围内，都能一趟地铁直达。
- **想住在华人社区的新移民：** Yonge 与 Finch 以及 Willowdale 的街区，中餐馆、华人超市、中文服务步行可达。
- **喜欢安静：** Bayview Village 和 Yonge 街以东的住宅区更清静，又离 4号线不远。

看房时，最好在你平时通勤的时段实地走一遍从门口到地铁站的路，再看看周边超市、诊所和晚上的街道环境。合租的话，提前和室友聊清楚作息、做饭频率、访客和清洁分工，写进室友协议，后面会省很多麻烦。

## 北约克租房还要注意什么

- **地下室：** 多伦多的分区规定允许大多数独立屋设第二套房，但还要符合建筑和消防规范，看房时检查第二出口和烟雾、一氧化碳报警器。
- **翻新驱逐：** 自2025年7月31日起，多伦多房东因装修发出 N13 通知后，须在7天内向市政府申请租赁翻新许可。N13 不是驱逐令，只有房东租客委员会 (LTB) 能下令让你搬走。
- **租金管制：** 2018年11月15日之后首次入住的单位涨租没有上限，北约克很多新 condo 属于这种情况，签约前心里要有数。

*本文为一般信息，不构成法律建议。具体情况请咨询房东租客委员会 (LTB) 或社区法律诊所。*

## 常见问题

**北约克属于多伦多吗？**
属于。北约克 (North York) 原本是独立城市，1998年并入多伦多市。现在由 TTC 提供公共交通，多伦多市的各项规定，比如合租屋执照和翻新驱逐许可条例，在北约克同样适用。

**住北约克比住市中心便宜吗？**
很多时候是，但不绝对。同样的预算，在北约克尤其是离地铁站几站远的地方，通常能住得更宽敞；不过紧挨主要地铁站的新 condo，价格可能接近市中心。比较时要把交通和水电网等费用一起算。

**Seneca Newnham 校区的学生住哪里？**
Seneca 的 Newnham 校区在 Finch Avenue East 与404公路附近，很多学生住在 4号线 Don Mills 站周边、Don Valley Village，或者 1号线 Finch 站附近，再坐公交去学校。签约前先查清上下课时间段的公交班次。

**从北约克去市中心方便吗？**
Yonge 街沿线的北约克大部分都在 1号线上，坐地铁可以直达市中心。具体用时取决于出发地点，建议用 TTC 行程规划按你的地址查询，高峰期或地铁临时停运时要多留时间。

# Oakville Rentals: A Guide to Oakville and Burlington

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/blog/renting-in-oakville-burlington/
Language: English
Updated: 2026-11-21

Oakville rentals and Burlington rentals compared: main areas, rooms near Sheridan College, the GO train commute to Toronto and what to check before you sign.

Oakville rentals and Burlington rentals give you lakeside towns, quieter streets and a direct GO train line to downtown Toronto, at the cost of a more car-oriented daily life away from the stations. The smartest way to choose is to pick your GO station or campus first, then look for a room, basement or condo within an easy walk or a single bus ride of it.

This guide covers how transit actually works, which areas suit which renters, what students near Sheridan College should know, and what to check before you sign. If you're still comparing the whole GTA, start with our guide to [the best neighbourhoods to rent in Toronto](/blog/best-toronto-neighbourhoods-for-young-professionals/).

## Key takeaways

- **The GO Lakeshore West line is the backbone.** Oakville has Oakville GO and Bronte GO; Burlington has Appleby, Burlington and Aldershot.
- **Local buses connect to GO for free with PRESTO.** Both Oakville Transit and Burlington Transit offer free co-fare connections with GO.
- **Sheridan's Trafalgar Road campus** is Oakville's main student hub, served by Oakville Transit from Oakville GO.
- **Expect houses, basements and condos.** Rooms in detached homes and basement units are common; condos cluster near downtown cores and GO stations.
- **Check basement legality and whether the host lives there**, since both change your protections.

## Who Oakville and Burlington suit

These towns tend to work well for people who value space and quiet over nightlife: hybrid workers who go downtown a few days a week, Sheridan students, couples, and newcomers with family or a job in Halton. If you want to step out your door into late-night restaurants and the subway every day, a Toronto neighbourhood is likely a better fit. Be honest about how often you'll actually travel into the city.

## Getting around: Oakville to Toronto commute by GO train

Metrolinx describes the Lakeshore West line as two-way, all-day service seven days a week between Union Station and Aldershot GO, with some trains continuing into Hamilton. From Oakville GO, the ride to Union is typically well under an hour; trains from Burlington's stations take longer. Check GO Transit's trip planner for the exact train you'd catch, because travel times vary by trip.

Service patterns change. In April 2026, Metrolinx announced the return of 15-minute weekend service between Oakville GO and Union in the afternoons and evenings. Don't assume the same frequency at every station or every hour.

### Local buses

- **Oakville Transit** feeds Oakville GO and Bronte GO and serves Sheridan's Trafalgar Road campus. Its fare page lists the GO co-fare as free when you tap PRESTO.
- **Burlington Transit** runs through its Downtown Terminal on John Street and connects at Burlington, Appleby and Aldershot GO. Burlington says connecting rides with GO are free with PRESTO.
- **Between the two towns**, Oakville Transit and Burlington Transit meet at Appleby GO.

Fare rules have fine print (GO e-tickets, for example, don't qualify for some discounts), so read the agency pages before you count on a free transfer.

### Driving

Many renters here drive, using the QEW, Highway 403 and Highway 407. If you need parking, ask whether a spot is included or costs extra, and whether street parking is allowed overnight in winter.

## Rooms for rent in Oakville: the main areas

| Area | Feels like | Good for | Transit notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Downtown Oakville and Kerr Village | Lakeside, walkable, older homes | Professionals who want shops and restaurants nearby | Close to Oakville GO by bus or bike |
| Around Oakville GO and Trafalgar Road | Mix of condos, towers and houses | Toronto commuters | Walk to the train |
| Bronte | Harbour village in west Oakville | Quieter living near the lake | Bronte GO in the area |
| College Park and Iroquois Ridge | Established suburbs near Sheridan | Sheridan students | Short bus ride to campus and GO |
| Glen Abbey, River Oaks, Uptown Core | Family suburbs, plazas | Renters with a car, basement units | Bus to GO; check frequency |
| North Oakville | Newer subdivisions | Newer basements and townhouses | Most car-dependent; check bus frequency |

## Renting near Sheridan College Oakville

Sheridan's **Trafalgar Road campus** is in Oakville. Sheridan also has campuses in Brampton and Mississauga, so confirm where your program runs before you sign anything.

- **Where students rent:** rooms and basements in the surrounding neighbourhoods, especially within a short Oakville Transit ride. Oakville Transit routes link the campus with Oakville GO.
- **On or off campus:** Sheridan has an on-campus residence at Trafalgar, but many students rent rooms off campus, often in shared houses.
- **Timing:** demand rises before each intake, so start looking several weeks before your term.
- **Live-in hosts:** many student rooms are in homes where the owner lives. If you share their kitchen or bathroom, the Residential Tenancies Act usually doesn't apply, so get the notice period and deposit terms in writing.

## Burlington rentals: the main areas

| Area | Feels like | Good for |
|---|---|---|
| Downtown Burlington | Waterfront, condos, Spencer Smith Park | Walkable living near the Downtown Terminal |
| Around Burlington GO (Fairview Street) | Condos and towers near the station | Toronto and Hamilton commuters |
| Aldershot | West end near Aldershot GO and Hamilton | Commuters heading either direction |
| Appleby and east Burlington | Established suburbs | Renters who use Appleby GO |
| North Burlington (Millcroft, Headon, Orchard, Alton Village) | Newer suburbs | Basements and townhouses, usually with a car |

Burlington's location between Oakville and Hamilton suits households where one person works toward Toronto and the other toward Hamilton.

## Oakville rentals and Burlington rentals: what you'll find

- **Rooms in houses:** the most affordable option, often with a live-in owner or a group of roommates.
- **Basement apartments:** common across both towns. Our guide to [legal basement apartments](/blog/legal-basement-apartments-toronto/) explains what to look for.
- **Condos:** concentrated in the downtown cores and around GO stations.
- **Purpose-built rental towers and townhouses:** scattered through older and newer areas alike.

## What to check before you sign

- [ ] **Commute test:** do the trip at rush hour, door to platform.
- [ ] **Basement basics:** a proper exit, smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, and whether it's a legal unit.
- [ ] **Who lives there:** sharing a kitchen or bathroom with the owner usually means the RTA doesn't apply.
- [ ] **Rent rules:** many units first occupied after November 15, 2018 aren't covered by the annual rent increase guideline. Ask when the unit was first rented.
- [ ] **Utilities and parking:** what's included, and how costs are split between roommates.
- [ ] **The lease:** most tenancies need the Ontario Standard Lease. Never pay before you've seen the unit and signed.

Also considering the next city east? Our guide to [renting in Mississauga](/blog/renting-in-mississauga/) covers the area around UTM and the Lakeshore West stations closer to Toronto.

## Find your Oakville or Burlington home

## FAQ

**Is Oakville or Burlington better for commuting to Toronto?**
Both sit on the GO Lakeshore West line, so the deciding factor is usually how close you live to a station. Oakville is closer to Union, while Burlington adds more train time but offers three stations to choose from. Check GO's trip planner from the exact address before you commit.

**Can I live in Oakville without a car?**
It's possible if you choose carefully. Living within walking distance of a GO station, downtown Oakville or a frequent Oakville Transit route makes it workable. Many suburban streets, especially in the north, are designed around driving, so test your daily trips first.

**Is Burlington cheaper than Oakville for renters?**
It depends on the unit type and area, and prices change month to month, so avoid relying on general claims. Compare current listings for the same kind of place, such as a room in a house or a one-bedroom condo, and include transit or parking costs in the total.

**Are basement apartments in Oakville and Burlington legal?**
Many are, but not all. Ask the landlord whether the unit is a legal secondary or additional residential unit and look for basics like a proper exit, smoke and carbon monoxide alarms and separate heating controls. If you're unsure, contact the Town of Oakville or City of Burlington.

**Should I rent near Oakville GO or near Sheridan?**
Choose based on where you go most days. If you commute to Toronto, walking distance to a GO station saves the most time; if you study at Sheridan, a short bus ride to campus matters more. Students with jobs or classes in both places often look along the Trafalgar Road corridor, which buses link to both campus and Oakville GO.

# 奥克维尔租房指南：伯灵顿对比与GO通勤

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/zh/blog/renting-in-oakville-burlington/
Language: Chinese (Simplified)
Updated: 2026-11-21

奥克维尔租房怎么选？对比奥克维尔和伯灵顿租房的主要社区、谢尔丹学院附近合租、坐GO火车通勤多伦多的实际情况，以及几个人组队租整栋house和签约前的必查清单。

奥克维尔租房（Oakville）和伯灵顿租房（Burlington）的最大吸引力，是湖边小城的安静、宽敞，以及一条直达多伦多市中心的GO火车线；代价是离开车站之后，日常生活更依赖开车。最聪明的选法是：先定下你要用的GO站或学校，再在步行或一趟公交能到的范围内找单间、地下室或condo。

很多在多伦多上班的新移民家庭、在谢尔丹学院（Sheridan College）读书的留学生，都会把这两个地方列进候选。这篇讲清交通怎么走、各个社区适合谁、谢尔丹学生要注意什么，以及签约前要查什么。如果你还在比较整个大多伦多地区，可以先看[多伦多上班族住哪里](/zh/blog/best-toronto-neighbourhoods-for-young-professionals/)。

## 要点速览

- **GO湖滨西线是主干**：奥克维尔有Oakville GO和Bronte GO两站；伯灵顿有Appleby、Burlington、Aldershot三站。
- **本地公交接驳GO，用PRESTO免费**：奥克维尔公交（Oakville Transit）和伯灵顿公交（Burlington Transit）都和GO有免费换乘安排。
- **谢尔丹学院Trafalgar Road校区**是奥克维尔最主要的学生聚集地，有公交连接Oakville GO站。
- **房源以house、地下室和condo为主**：house里的单间和地下室很常见，condo集中在老城区和GO站附近。
- **签约前查两件事**：地下室是否合法，房东是否同住，这两点都会影响你的权益。

## 这两座城适合谁？

奥克维尔和伯灵顿更适合看重空间和安静、而不是夜生活的人：每周去几天市中心的混合办公族、谢尔丹的学生、情侣，以及家人或工作在Halton地区的新移民。如果你希望一出门就是深夜餐馆和地铁，多伦多市区可能更合适。诚实地估计一下，你到底多久要进城一次。

## GO火车通勤多伦多：实际怎么走

Metrolinx介绍，湖滨西线在Union站和Aldershot GO之间提供全天双向、每周七天的服务，部分车次继续开往汉密尔顿。从Oakville GO坐到Union，通常不到一个小时；从伯灵顿各站出发会更久。具体时间因车次而异，以GO Transit行程规划查到的为准。

班次会调整。2026年4月，Metrolinx宣布恢复周末下午和晚上Oakville GO到Union之间每15分钟一班的服务。不要以为每个车站、每个时段都是这个频率。

### 本地公交

- **奥克维尔公交**接驳Oakville GO和Bronte GO，也连接谢尔丹Trafalgar Road校区。官网票价页写明，用PRESTO刷卡，和GO之间的联运（co-fare）免费。
- **伯灵顿公交**以John Street上的市中心总站（Downtown Terminal）为枢纽，在Burlington、Appleby、Aldershot三个GO站接驳。伯灵顿市政府说明，用PRESTO和GO联乘，公交部分免费。
- **两城之间**，奥克维尔公交和伯灵顿公交在Appleby GO站交汇。

票价规则有细节，比如GO电子票（e-ticket）不享受部分优惠，算"免费换乘"之前先看看官网。

### 开车

很多人在这里开车上下班，走QEW、403或407高速。需要车位的话，问清楚是否包含、要不要另付钱，以及冬天能不能在街边过夜停车。

## 奥克维尔合租：主要社区一览

| 区域 | 感觉 | 适合 | 交通 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 奥克维尔老城区和Kerr Village | 湖边、可步行、老房子多 | 想要餐馆和商店在身边的上班族 | 公交或骑车到Oakville GO |
| Oakville GO站和Trafalgar Road一带 | condo、公寓楼和house混合 | 去多伦多通勤的人 | 步行到火车站 |
| Bronte | 奥克维尔西部的港口小镇 | 喜欢湖边安静生活 | 附近有Bronte GO |
| College Park、Iroquois Ridge | 谢尔丹附近的成熟社区 | 谢尔丹学生合租 | 短途公交到学校和GO |
| Glen Abbey、River Oaks、Uptown Core | 家庭型社区，购物广场多 | 有车的人、地下室房源 | 公交到GO，注意班次 |
| 北奥克维尔 | 新建社区 | 较新的地下室和镇屋 | 最依赖开车，注意公交班次 |

### 谢尔丹学院附近租房

谢尔丹的**Trafalgar Road校区**在奥克维尔，学院另外在宾顿和密西沙加也有校区，签约前一定确认你的专业在哪个校区上课。

- **学生住哪里**：周边社区的单间和地下室，尤其是坐奥克维尔公交很快能到学校的地方。
- **校内还是校外**：Trafalgar校区有学生宿舍，但很多同学住校外，常见的是几个人合租一栋house。
- **时间**：每次开学前需求都会上升，最好提前几周开始找。
- **同住房东**：不少学生单间在房东自住的房子里。如果要和房东共用厨房或卫生间，住宅租赁法（Residential Tenancies Act, RTA）通常不适用，通知期和押金条款一定要写下来。

## 奥克维尔租房：几个人组队租一栋house

在奥克维尔和伯灵顿，整栋house出租比市中心常见得多。三四个同学或同事一起组队租下一栋房子，每人一间卧室，往往比各自去找单间更划算，也更自由：室友是自己挑的，家规大家一起定。

组队租要注意几件事：

- **谁签租约**：所有人都写进租约最稳妥，每个人都是租客，权利义务清楚；如果只有一个人签，其他人通常只是居住者，保障少很多。
- **房租怎么分**：主卧带独立卫生间的可以多分一点，提前写进室友协议。
- **有人提前走怎么办**：约定好室友之间的通知期，以及谁负责找接替的人。
- **水电网和扫雪除草**：house常常要租客自己负责部分账单和户外维护，签约前问清楚。

## 伯灵顿租房：主要社区一览

| 区域 | 感觉 | 适合 |
|---|---|---|
| 伯灵顿市中心 | 湖滨、condo多、Spencer Smith公园 | 想步行生活、靠近公交总站 |
| Burlington GO站（Fairview Street）一带 | 车站旁的condo和公寓楼 | 往多伦多或汉密尔顿通勤 |
| Aldershot | 西端，靠近Aldershot GO和汉密尔顿 | 两个方向都要跑的人 |
| Appleby和东伯灵顿 | 成熟社区 | 用Appleby GO的人 |
| 北伯灵顿（Millcroft、Headon、Orchard、Alton Village） | 较新的郊区 | 地下室和镇屋，通常需要车 |

伯灵顿夹在奥克维尔和汉密尔顿之间，特别适合一个人往多伦多上班、另一个人往汉密尔顿上班的家庭。

## 签约前必查清单

- [ ] **实测通勤**：在早高峰从家门口走到站台，看要多久。
- [ ] **地下室基本条件**：合规出口、烟雾和一氧化碳报警器，以及是否是合法单元。合法地下室的判断方法可以参考[多伦多地下室租房指南](/zh/blog/legal-basement-apartments-toronto/)。
- [ ] **谁住在这里**：和房东共用厨卫，通常意味着RTA不适用。
- [ ] **涨租规则**：2018年11月15日之后首次入住的不少单元，不受每年涨租指引的限制，问清楚这个单元什么时候第一次出租。
- [ ] **水电和车位**：包含哪些，室友之间怎么分。
- [ ] **租约**：大多数租赁要用安省标准租约（Ontario Standard Lease）。没看房、没签约，绝不付钱。

在微信群、小红书、51.ca、约克论坛上找奥克维尔或伯灵顿的房源时要格外小心：离市区远，很多人不方便专门跑一趟看房，骗子就会用"先付定金再看房"来催你。坚持视频实时看房，最好能当面看。

如果也在考虑往东一点的城市，可以看看[密西沙加租房](/zh/blog/renting-in-mississauga/)，里面介绍了UTM周边和离多伦多更近的湖滨西线车站。

## 常见问题

**住奥克维尔还是伯灵顿，通勤多伦多哪个方便？**
两地都在GO湖滨西线（Lakeshore West）上，真正决定通勤的是你离车站有多近。奥克维尔离Union站更近，伯灵顿坐车时间更长，但有三个车站可选。决定前，用GO的行程规划从具体地址查一下。

**在奥克维尔没有车能生活吗？**
可以，但要选对位置。住在GO站、奥克维尔老城区或者班次多的公交线路步行范围内，会方便很多。不少郊区街道，尤其是北部新区，基本是按开车设计的，签约前先把日常路线走一遍。

**伯灵顿租房比奥克维尔便宜吗？**
要看房型和区域，而且价格每个月都在变，不要轻信笼统的说法。拿同类房源比较，比如house里的单间或condo一室一厅，再把交通或停车费用算进总成本。

**奥克维尔和伯灵顿的地下室合法吗？**
很多是合法的，但不是全部。问房东这个单元是否是合法的附属住宅单元（secondary或additional residential unit），并检查是否有合规出口、烟雾和一氧化碳报警器。不确定可以联系奥克维尔镇政府或伯灵顿市政府。

**住GO站附近还是谢尔丹附近？**
看你每天主要去哪里。要去多伦多上班，步行到GO站最省时间；在谢尔丹上课，到学校的公交方便更重要。两边都要跑的同学，常在Trafalgar Road沿线找房，公交可以连接学校和奥克维尔GO站。

# Richmond Hill Rentals: 2026 Guide for Renters

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/blog/renting-in-richmond-hill/
Language: English
Updated: 2026-11-21

Browsing Richmond Hill rentals? Compare areas from Richmond Hill Centre to Oak Ridges, check a basement apartment safely and see where the subway stands.

Richmond Hill rentals are mostly condos along Yonge Street and Highway 7, basement apartments and rooms in detached houses, and a smaller number of townhouses. The city suits renters who want a quieter suburban base with strong Viva and YRT links to TTC Line 1 at Finch, and it has a large Chinese community. The Yonge North Subway Extension is under construction, but no official opening date has been announced, so choose a home that works with today's transit.

## Key takeaways

- **Condos cluster around Richmond Hill Centre** (Yonge and Highway 7) and along Yonge Street; rooms and basement suites are spread through the residential neighbourhoods.
- **Yonge Street and Highway 7 are the transit spine**, with Viva rapid transit and YRT buses connecting to Finch station.
- **Richmond Hill GO trains run mainly at weekday rush hours**, so they work best for a standard office commute.
- **The subway extension is being built**, with stations planned near Highway 7 and Highway 407, but don't count on a date.
- **Basement apartments are allowed on many lots**, but should be built with permits and to code. Check the safety basics before you sign.
- **Many landlords live on site.** Ask whether you'll share a kitchen or bathroom with the owner.

## Richmond Hill rentals: what you'll find

Richmond Hill stretches north from Highway 7 and Highway 407 up to Oak Ridges, with Yonge Street running through the middle. The main rental types are:

- **Condos** around Richmond Hill Centre and Langstaff, and at points along Yonge Street. Most are rented by individual owners.
- **Basement apartments** in detached houses across neighbourhoods like Bayview Hill, Rouge Woods, Jefferson and Oak Ridges.
- **Rooms in houses**, often with the owner or other tenants upstairs.
- **Townhouses** shared by roommate groups.

## Richmond Hill neighbourhoods at a glance

| Area | Good for | Main transit | Watch for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Richmond Hill Centre and Langstaff | Commuters, condo renters | Richmond Hill Centre Terminal (Viva, YRT), Langstaff GO | Subway construction, highway noise |
| Highway 7 and Leslie area | Tech workers, Chinese community | Viva on Highway 7, YRT | Car-oriented plazas |
| Yonge and 16th (Hillcrest) | Central, everyday convenience | Viva and YRT on Yonge | Older buildings vary in upkeep |
| Old Richmond Hill (Yonge and Major Mackenzie) | Walkable main street, hospital workers | Viva on Yonge, Richmond Hill GO | Limited condo supply |
| Bayview Hill and Rouge Woods | Quiet streets, basement suites | YRT on Bayview and Leslie | Infrequent evening buses |
| Oak Ridges | Nature, lakes and trails | YRT on Yonge | Long trips to Toronto |

Mackenzie Richmond Hill Hospital near Yonge and Major Mackenzie is a major local employer, and many healthcare workers rent nearby. If you're comparing York Region cities, our guide to [renting in Markham](/blog/renting-in-markham/) covers Richmond Hill's neighbour to the east.

## Richmond Hill basement apartment: what to check

Basement apartments are one of the most common and affordable Richmond Hill rentals. Under Zoning By-law 143-24, the City permits additional residential units, such as basement suites, on many residential lots, with exceptions for some areas, including floodplain zones. Zoning is only part of the picture, though. A suite should also meet the Ontario Building Code and Fire Code, and creating one generally requires a building permit; the City handles these through its additional residential unit permit process.

When you view a basement, check:

- **A safe second way out**, such as a proper egress window or a separate exit.
- **Working smoke alarms and carbon monoxide alarms**, especially near the furnace and bedrooms.
- **Ceiling height, heat and ventilation**, including signs of dampness or mould.
- **A separate entrance and lockable door** between your unit and the main house.
- **Paperwork.** Ask whether the suite was built with a building permit and passed inspection.

Even if a basement wasn't built with permits, the Residential Tenancies Act generally still protects you, unless you share a kitchen or bathroom with the owner. Our full guide to [legal basement apartments](/blog/legal-basement-apartments-toronto/) explains your rights and what to do about safety problems.

## Yonge North Subway Extension: where it stands

The Yonge North Subway Extension will carry TTC Line 1 about 8 kilometres north from Finch station. Metrolinx's current plan includes five new stations: Steeles, Clark and Royal Orchard underground, and Bridge and High Tech above ground near Highway 7 and Highway 407. In July 2026, Metrolinx said major construction was underway, including the launch shaft for the tunnel boring machines.

What this means for renters:

- **No official opening date has been announced**, so treat the subway as a long-term bonus, not a reason to accept a harder commute today.
- **Expect construction disruption** along Yonge Street near Steeles and Clark and around the Highway 7 area, including lane shifts and noise.
- **New condos near future stations** may advertise the subway heavily. Judge them on today's transit and price.

## Getting around Richmond Hill today

- **Viva rapid transit** runs along Yonge Street to Finch station and along Highway 7 east from Richmond Hill Centre toward Markham.
- **YRT local buses** cover the rest of the city, with less frequent service in outer neighbourhoods.
- **Richmond Hill GO line** stations include Langstaff, Richmond Hill and Gormley, with trains to Union Station at weekday rush hours.
- **One Fare** makes transfers between YRT and the TTC free when you pay with PRESTO, debit or credit.

## Tips before you sign in Richmond Hill

- **Walk the route.** Time the walk from the door to the nearest Viva or frequent YRT stop, and check evening and weekend schedules.
- **Confirm who you're renting from.** For a condo, make sure the person is the owner or a registered agent; for a room, ask whether the owner lives in the house.
- **Use the standard lease.** Most private rentals in Ontario must use the province's standard lease, rather than a homemade agreement.
- **Keep deposits legal.** A landlord can require a rent deposit of no more than one month's rent, used for your last month, plus a refundable key deposit.
- **Get extras in writing.** Parking, utilities, internet and furniture should all be listed in the lease or a signed addendum.

## Chinese community notes

Richmond Hill has a large Chinese-speaking population, especially around Highway 7 and Leslie, where Times Square and nearby plazas are busy with restaurants and shops. Many room and basement listings are posted in Chinese on WeChat groups, Xiaohongshu (RED), 51.ca and YorkBBS. These are handy for finding Mandarin- or Cantonese-speaking housemates, but scams appear there too. Verify the landlord, see the unit in person or on a live video call, and only pay once you have a written lease. North York is another popular choice for Chinese-speaking renters; see our guide to [North York apartments for rent](/blog/renting-in-north-york/).

*This is general information, not legal advice. For your situation, contact the Landlord and Tenant Board or a community legal clinic.*

## Finding roommates in Richmond Hill

## FAQ

**Can I live in Richmond Hill without a car?**
Yes, if you live close to Yonge Street or Highway 7, where Viva rapid transit and frequent YRT routes run. Neighbourhoods further east, west or north, such as parts of Oak Ridges, have less frequent buses. Check evening and weekend service for your exact address before signing.

**How do I get from Richmond Hill to downtown Toronto?**
The most common route is Viva or YRT down Yonge Street to Finch station, then TTC Line 1 south; One Fare makes that transfer free with PRESTO, debit or credit. Richmond Hill GO line trains run to Union Station at weekday rush hours, and driving via Highway 404 or Yonge Street is another option.

**Is it common to live with the landlord in Richmond Hill?**
Yes. Many rooms and basement suites are in homes where the owner lives. If you share a kitchen or bathroom with the owner, the Residential Tenancies Act usually doesn't apply, so ask about the arrangement and agree on house rules and notice in writing.

**Are there Chinese-speaking landlords and roommates in Richmond Hill?**
Yes, Richmond Hill has a large Chinese community, especially in the central and southern parts of the city around Highway 7. Many listings are posted in Chinese online. Use the same caution as with any listing: verify the landlord and see the unit before paying.

# 列治文山租房指南：地下室、交通与社区（2026）

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/zh/blog/renting-in-richmond-hill/
Language: Chinese (Simplified)
Updated: 2026-11-21

列治文山租房怎么选？各社区特点、地下室出租安全检查清单、Viva 和 GO 通勤方式，以及 Yonge 地铁北延线施工进展，华人新移民和留学生找房前必读。

列治文山租房，主要选择是 Yonge 街和7号公路沿线的 condo、独立屋里的地下室和单间，以及少量联排别墅。列治文山 (Richmond Hill) 环境安静、华人多，Viva 和 YRT 公交可以直达 TTC 1号线 Finch 站，适合想住郊区又要常去多伦多的人。Yonge 地铁北延线正在施工，但还没有官方通车日期，选房要按现在的交通条件来判断。

## 先看重点

- **condo 集中在 Richmond Hill Centre**（Yonge 街与7号公路交界）和 Yonge 街沿线，地下室和单间分布在各个住宅区。
- **交通主轴是 Yonge 街和7号公路：** Viva 快速公交和 YRT 公交连接 Finch 地铁站。
- **Richmond Hill 线 GO 火车以工作日高峰为主**，适合朝九晚五的通勤。
- **地铁北延线正在施工**，北段车站规划在7号公路和407公路附近，但不要指望具体日期。
- **很多地块允许建地下室单元**，但应有建筑许可、符合规范，签约前一定检查安全设施。
- **房东同住很常见：** 先问清楚是否要和房东共用厨房或卫生间。

## 列治文山租房：房源类型和社区

列治文山从7号公路和407公路一带向北延伸到 Oak Ridges，Yonge 街纵贯全城。常见房源有：

- **condo：** 集中在 Richmond Hill Centre、Langstaff 和 Yonge 街沿线，多为个人业主出租。
- **地下室：** Bayview Hill、Rouge Woods、Jefferson、Oak Ridges 等独立屋社区很多。
- **house 单间：** 楼上常住着房东或其他租客。
- **联排别墅：** 适合几个室友组队整租。

| 社区 | 适合人群 | 主要交通 | 注意事项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Richmond Hill Centre 与 Langstaff | 通勤族、租 condo | Richmond Hill Centre 公交总站 (Viva、YRT)、Langstaff GO | 地铁施工、高速公路噪音 |
| 7号公路与 Leslie 一带 | 科技公司上班族、华人 | 7号公路 Viva、YRT | 商业广场偏重开车 |
| Yonge 与16th (Hillcrest) | 位置居中、生活便利 | Yonge 街 Viva 和 YRT | 老楼维护水平参差 |
| 老城区 (Yonge 与 Major Mackenzie) | 喜欢步行老街、医院员工 | Yonge 街 Viva、Richmond Hill GO | condo 房源少 |
| Bayview Hill、Rouge Woods | 安静街区、地下室多 | Bayview、Leslie 上的 YRT | 晚间公交少 |
| Oak Ridges | 喜欢湖泊和步道 | Yonge 街 YRT | 去多伦多路程长 |

Yonge 与 Major Mackenzie 附近的 Mackenzie Richmond Hill 医院是本地大雇主，不少医护人员就近租房。想和隔壁对比，可以看[万锦租房](/zh/blog/renting-in-markham/)指南。

## 列治文山地下室出租：签约前怎么检查

地下室是列治文山最常见、也最实惠的房源之一。根据第143-24号分区条例 (Zoning By-law 143-24)，市政府允许在许多住宅地块上建附加住宅单元 (additional residential unit，比如地下室套房)，但洪泛区等部分区域除外。分区允许只是第一步，套房还应符合安省建筑规范和消防规范，新建一般需要建筑许可，市政府有专门的附加住宅单元许可流程。

看地下室时，请对照这份清单：

- **第二逃生出口：** 符合标准的逃生窗或独立出口。
- **烟雾报警器和一氧化碳报警器：** 能正常工作，炉房和卧室附近尤其重要。
- **层高、暖气和通风：** 注意有没有潮湿、霉味。
- **独立入口和可上锁的门：** 和主屋之间要有分隔。
- **相关文件：** 问房东套房是否有建筑许可、是否通过验收。

即使地下室当初没有申请许可，大多数情况下你仍受《住宅租赁法》(RTA) 保护，除非你和房东本人共用厨房或卫生间。详细权益和遇到安全问题怎么处理，请看[多伦多地下室租房](/zh/blog/legal-basement-apartments-toronto/)。

## 不同人群怎么选列治文山社区

- **去多伦多市中心上班：** 住在 Yonge 街 Viva 沿线，坐车到 Finch 站换地铁；如果是标准朝九晚五，Langstaff 或 Richmond Hill GO 站附近也很方便。
- **在本地科技公司上班：** 7号公路与 Leslie 一带的 condo 离办公园区近，周边华人餐馆和超市多。
- **医护人员：** Yonge 与 Major Mackenzie 附近的老城区离 Mackenzie Richmond Hill 医院近，可以步行或短途公交上班。
- **预算有限的留学生：** Bayview Hill、Rouge Woods 等社区的地下室单间较多，但要确认公交能否顺利到达学校。
- **喜欢自然、有车：** Oak Ridges 湖泊和步道多、环境安静，但去多伦多路程较长。

## 签约前快速清单

- 实地走一遍从门口到 Viva 或 YRT 站的路，查清晚上和周末的班次。
- condo 要确认对方是业主本人或注册经纪人；租单间要问清房东是否同住。
- 大部分私人出租房应使用安省标准租约，不要只签一张手写"协议"。
- 押金最多一个月租金（抵最后一个月房租），外加可退还的钥匙押金。
- 车位、水电、网络、家具、除雪等约定，都写进租约或签字的补充条款。

## Yonge 地铁北延线进展

Yonge 地铁北延线 (Yonge North Subway Extension) 将把 TTC 1号线从 Finch 站向北延长约8公里。Metrolinx 目前的方案包括五个新站：地下的 Steeles、Clark、Royal Orchard，以及位于7号公路和407公路附近、地面上的 Bridge 和 High Tech。2026年7月，Metrolinx 表示主体工程已全面展开，包括盾构机始发井。

对租客来说：

- **没有官方通车日期**，把地铁当作长期利好即可，不要为它接受眼下更辛苦的通勤。
- **施工影响：** Steeles、Clark 附近的 Yonge 街以及7号公路一带会有车道改道和噪音。看房时顺便留意施工围挡离住处有多远，夜间是否也有施工。
- **新 condo 宣传"地铁上盖"** 时，按现在的交通和价格来评估。

## 租 condo 和独立屋要注意的细节

在 Richmond Hill Centre、Langstaff 一带租 condo，要先看清楚大楼的规章 (condo rules)：搬家通常需要提前预约货梯，有的楼对访客停车、宠物、阳台烧烤都有限制，这些规定租客同样要遵守。签约时问清楚是否包车位、储物间、网络和水电，并把结果写进租约。

租独立屋里的地下室或单间，冬天要格外留意：暖气是否和楼上分开控制、窗户和门缝是否漏风、门口和车道的除雪由谁负责。地下室湿度较高，看房时摸一摸墙角、看看有没有水渍和霉斑，问问房东过去有没有漏水。

如果是和几个室友组队整租独立屋，签约前要商量好谁的名字上租约、房租和水电怎么分摊、有人提前搬走时怎么找人接替。最好把这些写成室友协议，大家签字各留一份。房东同住的情况下，也建议把安静时间、厨房使用、访客过夜、洗衣时间等规矩提前讲清楚，减少日后摩擦。

## 列治文山合租与华人找房渠道

列治文山华人很多，7号公路与 Leslie 一带的 Times Square 及周边广场餐馆商铺林立。很多单间和地下室信息发布在微信群、小红书、51.ca 和约克论坛上，方便找讲普通话或粤语的室友，但也常有骗局：盗用房源照片、催你"先付定金锁房"、只肯打字不肯视频。记住三条：核实房东身份，当面或实时视频看房，签了书面租约再付钱。房东最多只能要求一个月租金的押金，不能强制要求预付几个月房租。

日常出行方面：Viva 沿 Yonge 街到 Finch 站，并沿7号公路向东通往万锦；YRT 覆盖其他社区，外围班次较少；Richmond Hill 线 GO 站有 Langstaff、Richmond Hill、Gormley 等，工作日高峰直达 Union 站。用 PRESTO、借记卡或信用卡付费，YRT 与 TTC 换乘免费。如果更想住在多伦多市内，北约克也是华人租客的热门选择，可以看[北约克租房](/zh/blog/renting-in-north-york/)。

*本文为一般信息，不构成法律建议。具体情况请咨询房东租客委员会 (LTB) 或社区法律诊所。*

## 常见问题

**住列治文山没有车方便吗？**
住在 Yonge 街或7号公路附近比较方便，那里有 Viva 快速公交和班次较密的 YRT 公交。东西两侧和北边的 Oak Ridges 等社区公交班次少，签约前要查好你那个地址晚上和周末的公交。

**从列治文山去多伦多市中心怎么走？**
最常见的是坐 Viva 或 YRT 沿 Yonge 街到 Finch 站，再换 TTC 1号线南下；用 PRESTO、借记卡或信用卡付费，One Fare 政策下换乘免费。工作日高峰时段也可以坐 Richmond Hill 线 GO 火车直达 Union 站。

**Yonge 地铁北延线什么时候通车？**
目前没有官方公布的通车日期。Metrolinx 表示主体工程已在2026年全面展开，但签约时还是应该按现在的交通条件来判断通勤是否可行，别把未来的地铁当作选房理由。

**在列治文山和房东同住，要注意什么？**
如果你和房东本人共用厨房或卫生间，《住宅租赁法》(RTA) 通常不适用，退租通知、驱逐程序都和普通租约不同。入住前把房租、通知期、访客、安静时间等规矩写成书面协议，对双方都更有保障。

## 参考资料

# Scarborough Rooms for Rent: 2026 Renter's Guide

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/blog/renting-in-scarborough/
Language: English
Updated: 2026-11-21

Looking at Scarborough rooms for rent? Compare areas near UTSC and Centennial College, how transit works since Line 3 closed, and what to check before you sign.

Scarborough rooms for rent are usually easiest to find in three places: around UTSC in Highland Creek and West Hill, around Scarborough Centre and Centennial's Progress campus, and in established neighbourhoods like Agincourt near GO and bus links. Rooms here tend to cost less than comparable rooms downtown, and you often get more space. The trade-off is transit: since Line 3 closed, almost every trip starts with a bus, so pick your street around your commute.

This guide covers how getting around actually works in 2026, which areas suit which renters, and the checks that matter most for the kinds of homes you will see listed in Scarborough.

## Key takeaways

- **Commute first, room second.** Line 2 ends at Kennedy; most of Scarborough is reached by bus, the new Scarborough Busway, Line 5 or GO.
- **Students have two hubs.** UTSC in the east (Highland Creek) and Centennial's Progress campus near Scarborough Centre.
- **Houses dominate.** Expect many rooms in detached homes and basement units, plus condos around Scarborough Centre and older rental towers.
- **Licensing matters.** A house renting many rooms separately should hold a City multi-tenant house licence.
- **The subway extension is coming, not here.** Don't sign based on a future station.

## Getting around Scarborough in 2026

Transit in Scarborough changed a lot in the last few years, so older advice online is often out of date.

- **Line 2 Bloor-Danforth** runs east to Kennedy station, which is now the end of the line.
- **Line 3 Scarborough closed in 2023** and was replaced by buses. On September 30, 2026, the TTC opened the **Scarborough Busway** on part of the old Line 3 corridor, giving buses their own road between Kennedy and Scarborough Centre.
- **Line 5 Eglinton** opened in February 2026 and meets Line 2 at Kennedy, which makes Kennedy a major transfer point for trips west along Eglinton.
- **The Scarborough Subway Extension** (Line 2 east to Sheppard and McCowan) is under construction. Tunnelling is well along, but no firm opening date has been confirmed, so treat it as a long-term plus.
- **GO Transit** has stations on the Lakeshore East line (such as Guildwood and Rouge Hill) and the Stouffville line (such as Kennedy, Agincourt and Milliken). Under Ontario's One Fare Program, transfers between GO and the TTC are free within the time window when you pay with PRESTO, debit or credit.

## Renting near UTSC

### Where do students rent near UTSC?

The University of Toronto Scarborough sits on Military Trail in **Highland Creek**. The closest options are:

- **Highland Creek and West Hill:** quiet, leafy streets of detached houses. Many owners rent rooms or basement units to students, and some houses are shared by several students.
- **Morningside and Morningside Heights:** newer subdivisions north of the 401, with rooms in family homes and basements. Check bus frequency, since some streets are less well served.
- **Scarborough Centre:** further away but a big bus hub, with condos, the mall and Civic Centre. A good pick if you want city-style living and a direct express or busway connection.

Several TTC routes serve the campus, including express buses from Kennedy and other hubs. Check UTSC's own transit page, because route numbers and patterns change.

### Rent near UTSC: what to expect from the homes

Most rooms near campus are in owner-occupied houses. That matters legally: if you share a kitchen or bathroom with the owner or their close family who live there, Ontario's Residential Tenancies Act generally does not apply, so you rely on your written agreement. Ask at the viewing who lives in the house, and whether the owner shares the kitchen.

## Centennial College housing

### Which Centennial campus is yours?

Centennial College has several campuses. The two in Scarborough most students ask about are:

- **Progress campus** on Progress Avenue, near Scarborough Centre and Highway 401. It is the largest campus and has an on-campus residence.
- **Morningside campus**, close to UTSC, so the Highland Creek advice above applies.

### Where to live for the Progress campus

For Progress, look at **Scarborough Centre**, the **Woburn** area along Markham Road and Ellesmere, and nearby streets around Progress Avenue. These keep the bus ride short and give you shops and groceries nearby. Students who want a bigger social circle sometimes live further west along Line 2 and ride the busway, but that adds a transfer.

## Other Scarborough areas at a glance

| Area | What it suits | Things to check |
|---|---|---|
| Agincourt | Renters who want lots of Asian food and shops, GO access on the Stouffville line | Many rooms in shared houses; confirm who holds the lease |
| Kennedy and the Golden Mile | Commuters who want Line 2, Line 5 and GO in one place | Busy roads and ongoing construction in places |
| Scarborough Centre | Condo renters, students at Progress, anyone wanting a hub | Condo rules and move-in bookings |
| Highland Creek and West Hill | UTSC students, quiet living | Bus frequency late at night |
| Guildwood and Scarborough Village | Renters who like parks and the bluffs, Lakeshore East GO | Fewer shops within walking distance |
| Malvern and Morningside Heights | Budget-minded renters, families | Longer bus rides to most hubs |

For a fuller picture of rooms near every major campus, see our pillar guide to the [best neighbourhoods in Toronto for students](/blog/best-toronto-neighbourhoods-for-students/).

## Scarborough rooms for rent: what kinds of rentals you will find

- **Rooms in houses.** The most common listing. Sometimes the owner lives upstairs; sometimes a tenant rents the whole house and sublets rooms.
- **Basement apartments.** Plentiful and often good value. Check ceiling height, windows you could exit through, and a working smoke and carbon monoxide alarm. Our guide to [legal basement apartments in Toronto](/blog/legal-basement-apartments-toronto/) walks through the signs.
- **Condos.** Clustered around Scarborough Centre, Kennedy and along Sheppard. Expect building rules, fobs and elevator bookings.
- **Purpose-built rental towers.** Older apartment buildings along major roads, often with on-site management.
- **Multi-tenant houses.** Since March 31, 2024, rooming houses are permitted across Toronto, but operators need a City licence.

## What to watch for before you sign in Scarborough

- [ ] **Who are you renting from?** Owner, tenant subletting rooms, or agent. Ask to see proof the person can rent the room.
- [ ] **Is the owner sharing the kitchen or bathroom?** If yes, your protections may differ.
- [ ] **Is there a written lease?** Most tenancies covered by the Act must use Ontario's standard lease.
- [ ] **Deposits.** In covered tenancies, a landlord can collect a last month's rent deposit and a refundable key deposit, not a "damage deposit."
- [ ] **Safety basics.** Working smoke and CO alarms, a second way out of basement units, and a lock on your bedroom door if it is a shared house.
- [ ] **Too-good prices and pressure.** Scams target students searching from overseas. Never pay before you have seen the room, live or in person.

This is general information, not legal advice. If you are unsure whether the Residential Tenancies Act covers your room, contact the Landlord and Tenant Board or a community legal clinic.

## FAQ

**Where should I rent near UTSC?**
Highland Creek, West Hill and the Morningside area are the closest residential pockets, and many houses there rent rooms or basement units to students. Scarborough Centre is a good second choice if you want condos, a mall and a bus hub. Check the bus route from the exact address before you sign, since walking distance varies a lot.

**Is there student housing for Centennial College?**
Centennial's Progress campus has an on-campus residence, but many students rent rooms off campus. Popular choices are the neighbourhoods around Scarborough Centre, Progress Avenue and Markham Road, which keep the bus ride short. Centennial also has a Morningside campus close to UTSC, so confirm which campus your program uses.

**Is Scarborough a good place to rent without a car?**
It can be, if you choose carefully. Line 2 ends at Kennedy, the Scarborough Busway links Kennedy with Scarborough Centre, Line 5 Eglinton meets Line 2 at Kennedy, and GO trains serve stations on the Lakeshore East and Stouffville lines. Living near one of those hubs or a frequent bus route makes car-free life much easier.

**When will the Scarborough Subway Extension open?**
It is under construction, with tunnelling well advanced, but there is no firm opening date you can plan a lease around. Choose a home that works with today's buses and trains, and treat the subway as a future bonus.

**Are rooming houses legal in Scarborough?**
Since March 31, 2024, multi-tenant (rooming) houses are permitted across all of Toronto, including Scarborough, but operators need a City licence. If a house rents many rooms to separate people, ask whether it is licensed and check basic fire safety such as smoke and carbon monoxide alarms.

# 士嘉堡租房指南：UTSC附近怎么选（2026）

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/zh/blog/renting-in-scarborough/
Language: Chinese (Simplified)
Updated: 2026-11-21

士嘉堡租房怎么选？UTSC、Centennial附近哪些社区适合学生合租，3号线停运后公交和快速公交怎么坐，地下室和合租屋看房签约要注意什么，一篇讲清。

士嘉堡租房，一般集中在三个片区：UTSC 周边的 Highland Creek 和 West Hill，Scarborough Centre 和 Centennial 学院 Progress 校区一带，以及华人很多、交通方便的 Agincourt。和市中心比，同样的预算在士嘉堡 (Scarborough) 往往能租到更大的房间；代价是通勤，3号线停运以后，大部分出行都要先坐公交车，所以一定要**先定通勤，再挑房子**。

下面按交通、校区、片区、房源类型和签约注意事项，帮你把士嘉堡学生合租的思路理一遍。

## 先看要点

- **通勤第一**：2号线只到 Kennedy 站，士嘉堡大部分地方要靠公交、快速公交专用道、5号线或 GO 火车。
- **两大学生圈**：东边的 UTSC（Highland Creek），中部的 Centennial Progress 校区（Scarborough Centre 附近）。
- **房源以独立屋为主**：单间、地下室最多；公寓集中在 Scarborough Centre 一带。
- **合租屋要有执照**：分房间出租给多人的房子，应持有市政府的多租户住宅执照。
- **地铁延长线还在建**：别因为"以后有地铁"就多付钱。

## 士嘉堡交通：2026年的真实情况

网上很多攻略还停留在3号线时代，先把现状说清楚：

- **2号线 (Line 2 Bloor-Danforth)** 东边终点是 Kennedy 站。
- **3号线 (Line 3 Scarborough) 已于2023年永久停运**，改由公交车替代。2026年9月30日，TTC 在原3号线的一段线路上开通了**士嘉堡快速公交专用道 (Scarborough Busway)**，公交车在 Kennedy 和 Scarborough Centre 之间走专用道，不再和私家车抢路。
- **5号线 Eglinton (Line 5)** 于2026年2月通车，在 Kennedy 站和2号线换乘，往西去 Eglinton 沿线方便了不少。
- **士嘉堡地铁延长线 (Scarborough Subway Extension)**：2号线向东延伸到 Sheppard 和 McCowan 一带，正在施工，但没有确定的通车日期，不要把它当成选房依据。
- **GO 火车**：Lakeshore East 线（如 Guildwood、Rouge Hill 站）和 Stouffville 线（如 Kennedy、Agincourt、Milliken 站）都经过士嘉堡。按安省的 One Fare 一票通政策，用 PRESTO、借记卡或信用卡付费，在规定时间内 GO 和 TTC 之间换乘免费。

## UTSC附近租房

### UTSC附近住哪里？

多大士嘉堡校区 (UTSC) 在 Military Trail，属于 **Highland Creek** 社区。常见选择：

- **Highland Creek、West Hill**：安静、绿化好，以独立屋为主。很多房东出租单间或地下室给学生，也有几个同学一起合租整栋。
- **Morningside、Morningside Heights**：401 高速以北的较新住宅区，家庭屋出租房间和地下室比较多。有些街道公交班次少，要查清楚。
- **Scarborough Centre**：离学校远一点，但是公交枢纽，公寓、商场、市政中心都在这里，适合想要"城市感"的同学。

去 UTSC 的 TTC 线路有好几条，包括从 Kennedy 等枢纽出发的快线。线路编号会调整，以 UTSC 官网的交通页面为准。

### 和房东同住要知道的一点

UTSC 周边很多房子是房东自住、楼上住房东楼下租学生。如果你和房东本人或其近亲**共用厨房或卫生间**，安省《住宅租赁法》(Residential Tenancies Act) 一般不适用，你的权益主要靠书面协议。看房时直接问：家里住了谁？厨房是不是和房东共用？

## 士嘉堡学生合租：Centennial学院怎么选

Centennial College 有好几个校区，士嘉堡同学最常问的是两个：

- **Progress 校区**：在 Progress Avenue，靠近 Scarborough Centre 和 401 高速，是最大的校区，有校内宿舍。
- **Morningside 校区**：离 UTSC 很近，上面 Highland Creek 的建议同样适用。

读 Progress 校区，可以看 **Scarborough Centre**、Markham Road 和 Ellesmere 交界的 **Woburn** 一带，以及 Progress Avenue 周边，通勤短，买菜吃饭也方便。

## 其他片区一览

| 片区 | 适合谁 | 要注意什么 |
|---|---|---|
| Agincourt | 喜欢中餐、亚洲超市多的地方；Stouffville 线 GO 方便 | 合租屋多，问清楚谁是签租约的人 |
| Kennedy 和 Golden Mile | 需要2号线、5号线、GO 一站换乘的上班族 | 主干道车多，部分路段在施工 |
| Scarborough Centre | 租公寓、读 Progress 的同学 | 公寓规定、搬家要预约电梯 |
| Highland Creek、West Hill | UTSC 学生、喜欢安静 | 深夜公交班次 |
| Guildwood、Scarborough Village | 喜欢公园和湖边悬崖；Lakeshore East 线 GO | 步行范围内商店少 |
| Malvern、Morningside Heights | 预算紧的同学、家庭 | 去枢纽的公交时间较长 |

想看全多伦多各校区周边的对比，可以读我们的支柱文章 [多伦多留学生住哪里](/zh/blog/best-toronto-neighbourhoods-for-students/)。

## 士嘉堡租房：常见的房源类型

- **独立屋单间**：最常见。有时房东住楼上；有时是一个租客整租后再分租房间（俗称"二房东"）。
- **地下室**：数量多、性价比高。看房时注意层高、能逃生的窗户、烟雾和一氧化碳报警器。详见 [多伦多地下室租房](/zh/blog/legal-basement-apartments-toronto/)。
- **公寓 (condo)**：集中在 Scarborough Centre、Kennedy 和 Sheppard 沿线，有门禁卡、电梯预约等楼宇规定。
- **出租公寓楼**：主干道边的老式出租楼，一般有物业管理。
- **多租户合租屋**：2024年3月31日起全市允许，但必须有市政府执照。

## 士嘉堡学生合租：几个实用建议

### 人还在国内，怎么找房？

很多新生是落地前就要定好住处的。比较稳妥的做法是：

1. **先订两三周短住**，落地后再实地看房。士嘉堡房源多，开学前后也常有新房源放出来，不必在国内就仓促交钱。
2. **一定要视频看房**，而且是对方拿着手机实时走一遍每个房间，而不是发几张照片或一段录好的视频。
3. **让在多伦多的朋友或学长学姐帮忙实地看**，顺便看看周边环境和公交站。
4. **核实出租人身份**：问清楚是业主本人还是二房东；如果是二房东，请对方出示自己的租约以及房东同意分租的证明。

### 和几个同学一起整租，要先说好什么？

几个人一起整租一栋房子或一套公寓，平均下来通常比各自单租便宜，但要先把规则说清楚：

- **谁签租约？** 所有人都签，还是一个人签再分租给其他人？前者大家对房东的责任一样，后者签约人风险更大。
- **房间怎么分价？** 主卧带独卫、地下室房间、小次卧，价格应该不一样。
- **水电网怎么摊？** 士嘉堡独立屋冬天暖气费不低，最好提前约定按人头还是按房间分。
- **有人提前走怎么办？** 通知期多长、是否要负责找人接手。

这些最好写进一份简单的室友协议，大家签字各留一份。

### 冬天通勤别低估

士嘉堡冬天风大雪多，等车时间一长就很难熬。看房时顺便留意：从家门口到公交站的路有没有人行道、晚上路灯够不够、站台有没有候车亭。上晚课的同学还要查一下末班车时间。

## 签约前的检查清单

- [ ] **跟谁租？** 房东本人、二房东还是经纪？请对方证明自己有权出租这个房间。
- [ ] **是否和房东共用厨房或卫生间？** 如果是，你的保护可能不同。
- [ ] **有没有书面租约？** 受《住宅租赁法》保护的租赁，大多要用安省标准租约 (Ontario standard lease)。
- [ ] **押金**：受法律保护的租赁，房东可以收最后一个月房租押金和可退的钥匙押金，不能另收"损坏押金"。
- [ ] **安全**：报警器能用、地下室有第二出口、合租屋卧室门能上锁。
- [ ] **价格低得离谱、催你马上转账**：这是诈骗常见套路。

关于找房渠道：微信群、小红书、51.ca、约克论坛上士嘉堡的房源很多，信息也最杂。不少骗子专门盯着还在国内、没法看房的新生，**没看过房、没签租约之前，一分钱都不要转**。

以上是一般性信息，不构成法律建议。不确定自己的情况是否受《住宅租赁法》保护，可以咨询房东与租客委员会 (LTB) 或社区法律诊所。

## 常见问题

**UTSC附近租房一般住哪里？**
离多大士嘉堡校区 (UTSC) 最近的是 Highland Creek、West Hill 和 Morningside 一带，很多独立屋出租单间或地下室给学生。想住公寓、离商场近，可以考虑 Scarborough Centre，公交枢纽在那里。签约前用具体地址查一下去学校的公交路线和班次。

**在士嘉堡没有车生活方便吗？**
选对位置就不难。2号线终点在 Kennedy 站，士嘉堡快速公交专用道 (Scarborough Busway) 连接 Kennedy 和 Scarborough Centre，5号线 Eglinton 也在 Kennedy 换乘，另外还有 GO 火车站。住在这些枢纽或高频公交线附近，没车也能过得不错。

**士嘉堡地铁延长线什么时候通车？**
士嘉堡地铁延长线 (Scarborough Subway Extension) 正在建设，隧道工程已经推进了一大半，但目前没有可以拿来规划租约的确定通车日期。选房还是要按现有的公交和火车来算，地铁只能当作以后的加分项。

**士嘉堡的合租屋合法吗？**
从2024年3月31日起，多租户住宅 (multi-tenant / rooming house) 在全多伦多（包括士嘉堡）都允许经营，但经营者必须持有市政府执照。如果一栋房子把很多房间分别租给不同的人，可以直接问房东有没有执照，并检查烟雾和一氧化碳报警器。

**Centennial学院的学生住哪里比较方便？**
读 Progress 校区的话，Scarborough Centre、Progress Avenue 和 Markham Road 一带公交最短。Centennial 还有一个 Morningside 校区，离 UTSC 很近，住 Highland Creek 更合适。先确认你的专业在哪个校区上课。

## 参考资料

- [TTC：The future of Line 3 Scarborough（3号线停运后的安排）](https://www.ttc.ca/about-the-ttc/projects-and-plans/Future-of-Line-3-Scarborough)
- [Metrolinx：Scarborough Subway Extension（士嘉堡地铁延长线）](https://www.metrolinx.com/en/projects-and-programs/scarborough-subway-extension)

# Vaughan Rentals: VMC Condos, Areas and Commutes

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/blog/renting-in-vaughan/
Language: English
Updated: 2026-11-21

Searching Vaughan rentals? Compare VMC condos, Woodbridge, Maple and Thornhill, see how Line 1, Viva and GO connect, and what to check before signing a lease.

Vaughan rentals fall into two very different worlds: new high-rise condos around Vaughan Metropolitan Centre (VMC), where Line 1 ends, and suburban houses in Woodbridge, Maple, Concord and Thornhill that rent rooms, basements and whole homes. If you commute to York University or downtown by subway, VMC is the obvious starting point. If you want more space, a quieter street or a lower cost per person, a room or basement in a nearby house is usually worth comparing.

Here's how the city is laid out for renters, how transit really connects, and what to check before you hand over any money.

## Key takeaways

- **VMC is the transit anchor.** Line 1, the Viva Orange rapidway on Highway 7 and the YRT bus terminal all meet there.
- **York University is close by subway.** It's three stops south of VMC on Line 1.
- **Outside VMC, Vaughan is car-friendly first.** Check bus frequency from the exact address if you don't drive.
- **Most non-condo rentals are in houses.** Rooms, basements and whole homes shared by roommates.
- **Secondary suites have rules.** Vaughan permits them only in certain house types and they must meet zoning, Building Code and Fire Code requirements.

## Getting around Vaughan

- **TTC Line 1** runs north through York University to **Vaughan Metropolitan Centre** at Highway 7 and Jane. The extension opened in December 2017, so you can ride straight to downtown without a transfer.
- **YRT and Viva.** York Region Transit runs local buses across Vaughan, and **Viva Orange** runs along the Highway 7 rapidway in dedicated lanes. At VMC, the Viva platforms and the SmartVMC bus terminal connect to the subway through underground passages.
- **GO Transit.** **Maple** and **Rutherford** stations on the Barrie line serve central Vaughan, with trains toward Union Station.
- **One Fare.** Since February 2024, transfers between YRT and the TTC (and GO) are free within the transfer window when you tap PRESTO, debit or credit, so a bus-plus-subway commute no longer means paying twice.

### Vaughan to York University commute

## Vaughan Metropolitan Centre condos

VMC is Vaughan's new downtown, built up around the subway station with towers, offices, a transit hub and parks still taking shape.

**Who it suits:** York University students, commuters along Line 1, and young professionals who want amenities like a gym, concierge and parcel room.

**What to expect when renting a VMC condo:**

- **Building rules apply to you.** As a tenant you must follow the condo's declaration, by-laws and rules, including move-in elevator bookings, amenity hours and guest parking.
- **Ask what's included.** Some units come with parking or a locker, some don't. Ask who pays hydro and water, since many newer condos meter them separately.
- **Shared condos are common.** Two-bedroom units are often rented by two roommates or by a tenant who rents out the second room. Ask whether everyone will be on the lease.
- **Construction is part of the scene.** VMC is still being built, so expect cranes and some noise nearby.

Planning a condo move? Our guide to [renting a condo in downtown Toronto](/blog/renting-a-condo-downtown-toronto/) covers condo rules, fobs and elevator bookings in more detail, and it applies in Vaughan too.

## Vaughan neighbourhoods at a glance

| Area | What it suits | Things to check |
|---|---|---|
| Vaughan Metropolitan Centre | Subway commuters, York students, condo renters | Parking and utility costs, condo rules |
| Concord | People working along Highway 7 and the 407 corridor | Mix of industrial and residential; walkability varies |
| Thornhill (Vaughan side) | Renters wanting established suburbs and easy access to Toronto | Bus connections to Line 1 differ street to street |
| Woodbridge | Families and renters who like a settled community with local shops | Car-oriented; bus frequency |
| Maple | Commuters using Maple GO; workers at Cortellucci Vaughan Hospital | Rooms and basements in family homes; check legality |
| Vellore, Kleinburg and the north | People who drive and want quieter, newer subdivisions | Few transit options; fewer rentals listed |

Weighing Vaughan against other commuter areas? Our pillar guide to the [best neighbourhoods to rent in Toronto](/blog/best-toronto-neighbourhoods-for-young-professionals/) compares areas by commute and lifestyle, and our [North York renting guide](/blog/renting-in-north-york/) covers the Line 1 neighbourhoods just south of Steeles.

## Types of Vaughan rentals

- **Condo units** around VMC and along Highway 7, often rented whole or shared by two roommates.
- **Rooms in houses**, sometimes in owner-occupied homes. If you share a kitchen or bathroom with the owner or their close family, the Residential Tenancies Act generally doesn't apply, so your written agreement matters more.
- **Basement apartments.** Vaughan allows secondary suites in specific detached, semi-detached and street townhouses, as long as they meet zoning, the Building Code and the Fire Code.
- **Whole houses** rented by a group of roommates, sometimes room by room.

### Vaughan or closer to the core?

If you're torn between Vaughan and North York or downtown, compare three things: rent and space (house rooms in Vaughan are often bigger and may include parking), transport costs (a VMC renter who rides the subway pays much the same as a Toronto renter, but a car in Woodbridge adds insurance, gas and parking), and time (Highway 400 and 407 traffic at rush hour can make driving slower than the subway). Check both options at your real travel times.

## What to watch for before you sign

- [ ] **Confirm who you are renting from.** Owner, registered agent or tenant subletting. If an agent is involved, check them on RECO's public register.
- [ ] **Get a written lease.** Most residential tenancies in Ontario use the standard lease form.
- [ ] **Know the deposit rules.** In covered tenancies, a landlord can take a last month's rent deposit and a refundable key or fob deposit, not a separate damage deposit.
- [ ] **For basements, check safety.** Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, a window or door you could escape through, and adequate ceiling height.
- [ ] **For condos, get the rules.** Ask for a copy of the building rules and the move-in procedure before move-in day.
- [ ] **Beware of too-good deals.** Never pay a deposit before viewing the actual unit and seeing a lease.

This is general information, not legal advice. For questions about your rights, contact the Landlord and Tenant Board or a community legal clinic.

## FAQ

**How do I commute from Vaughan to York University?**
From Vaughan Metropolitan Centre, take Line 1 south: York University station is three stops away, after Highway 407 and Pioneer Village. If you live elsewhere in Vaughan, a YRT or Viva bus to VMC or Pioneer Village usually gets you onto the subway. With PRESTO, debit or credit, the One Fare Program makes YRT-to-TTC transfers free within the transfer window.

**Is renting a condo at Vaughan Metropolitan Centre worth it?**
It suits people who want new buildings, amenities and a subway station at the door, especially commuters to York University or downtown along Line 1. You trade a quieter suburban street for a busy, still-growing district. Compare total monthly cost, including parking and utilities, against a room in a nearby house.

**Can I live in Vaughan without a car?**
Around VMC and along the Highway 7 Viva corridor, yes for most daily needs. In much of Woodbridge, Maple and Kleinburg, life is more car-oriented and buses run less often, so check routes and frequencies from the exact address.

**Are basement apartments legal in Vaughan?**
Vaughan permits secondary suites in certain detached, semi-detached and street townhouses, as long as they meet the zoning by-law, the Ontario Building Code and the Fire Code. Ask the landlord whether the unit was built with a permit, and look for safety basics like alarms and a proper exit.

**Which GO stations are in Vaughan?**
Maple and Rutherford stations on the Barrie line are in Vaughan. They are handy if you work downtown near Union, but check the schedule for your hours, since service levels vary through the day.

- [Transfers with the TTC One Fare Program (YRT)](https://www.yrt.ca/en/fares-and-passes/transfers-with-ttc-one-fare-program.aspx)

- [Barrie line expansion (Metrolinx)](https://www.metrolinx.com/en/discover/go-expansion-progresses-along-the-barrie-line)

# 旺市租房指南：VMC公寓与各社区怎么选

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/zh/blog/renting-in-vaughan/
Language: Chinese (Simplified)
Updated: 2026-11-21

旺市租房怎么选？旺市VMC公寓、Woodbridge、Maple、Thornhill各适合谁，1号线、Viva和GO怎么通勤，去约克大学多远，签约前要查什么，一篇讲清。

旺市租房，基本分成两种：一种是 1 号线终点 Vaughan Metropolitan Centre（VMC）周边的新建高层公寓，另一种是 Woodbridge、Maple、Concord、Thornhill 等社区的独立屋，出租单间、地下室或整栋。每天坐地铁去约克大学或市中心，旺市VMC公寓是首选；想要更大空间、更安静的环境，或者想多人分摊降低成本，附近独立屋的房间和地下室也值得比较。

旺市 (Vaughan) 属于约克区 (York Region)，在多伦多正北边，和北约克隔着 Steeles Avenue。下面按交通、社区、房源类型和签约要点一一说明。

## 先看要点

- **VMC 是交通核心**：1号线、7号公路上的 Viva Orange 快速公交和 YRT 公交总站都在这里交汇。
- **去约克大学很近**：从 VMC 坐1号线往南第三站就是 York University 站。
- **VMC 以外偏向开车生活**：没车的话，一定要用具体地址查公交班次。
- **公寓以外的房源大多在独立屋里**：单间、地下室、几个人合租整栋。
- **地下室有规定**：旺市只允许在特定房型里设二套房，并须符合区划、建筑和消防规范。

## 旺市交通怎么走

- **TTC 1号线**：经约克大学一路向北，终点是7号公路和 Jane Street 交界处的 **Vaughan Metropolitan Centre** 站。这段延长线2017年12月通车，从 VMC 可以一趟坐到市中心，不用换乘。
- **YRT 和 Viva**：约克区公交 (York Region Transit) 覆盖旺市各社区；**Viva Orange** 在7号公路的快速公交专用道上运行。在 VMC，Viva 站台、SmartVMC 公交总站和地铁站之间有地下通道相连，冬天换乘不用出门。
- **GO 火车**：Barrie 线上的 **Maple** 站和 **Rutherford** 站在旺市中部，可直达 Union 站。
- **一票通 (One Fare)**：从2024年2月起，用 PRESTO、借记卡或信用卡付费，YRT、TTC 和 GO 之间在规定时间内换乘免费，"公交加地铁"不用再付两次钱。

### 旺市到约克大学怎么走

## 旺市VMC公寓：适合谁，要注意什么

VMC 是旺市正在打造的"新市中心"，围绕地铁站有不少高层公寓、写字楼和公园，很多地块还在施工。

**适合谁**：约克大学学生、沿1号线通勤的上班族、喜欢健身房、礼宾、快递室等公寓设施的年轻人。

**租 VMC 公寓要知道的几点：**

- **楼宇规定对租客同样有约束**：公寓的章程 (declaration)、细则 (by-laws) 和规定 (rules)，比如搬家预约电梯、设施开放时间、访客停车，租客都必须遵守。
- **问清楚包含什么**：有的单位带车位或储物柜，有的不带；水电费是否单独计量、由谁付，也要事先问清。
- **两室合租很常见**：两室单位常由两个室友一起租，或者由一个租客把次卧再租出去。问清楚是不是每个人都在租约上。
- **周边还在建设**：塔吊和施工噪音在一段时间内难免。

搬进公寓前的电梯预约、门禁卡、押金等细节，可以看我们的 [多伦多市中心公寓出租注意事项](/zh/blog/renting-a-condo-downtown-toronto/)，在旺市同样适用。

## 旺市租房：各社区一览

| 社区 | 适合谁 | 要注意什么 |
|---|---|---|
| Vaughan Metropolitan Centre | 地铁通勤族、约克学生、想租公寓的人 | 停车和水电成本、公寓规定 |
| Concord | 在7号公路、407 一带上班的人 | 工业区和住宅混合，步行便利度不一 |
| Thornhill（旺市一侧） | 想住成熟社区、方便进多伦多的人 | 不同街道接驳地铁的公交差别大 |
| Woodbridge | 家庭、喜欢社区氛围和本地小店的人 | 偏开车生活，公交班次少 |
| Maple | 用 Maple GO 通勤的人、在 Cortellucci Vaughan Hospital 工作的人 | 家庭屋出租单间和地下室，注意是否合规 |
| Vellore、Kleinburg 及北部 | 有车、喜欢新社区和安静的人 | 公交少，出租房源也少 |

如果你在旺市和其他通勤区之间犹豫，可以先读我们的支柱文章 [多伦多上班族住哪里](/zh/blog/best-toronto-neighbourhoods-for-young-professionals/)，按通勤和生活方式比较各区；Steeles 以南的1号线社区可以看 [北约克租房](/zh/blog/renting-in-north-york/)。

## 旺市合租：常见房源类型

- **公寓单位**：集中在 VMC 和7号公路沿线，可以整租，也常见两人合租。
- **独立屋单间**：有些是房东自住。注意：如果你和房东本人或其近亲**共用厨房或卫生间**，安省《住宅租赁法》(Residential Tenancies Act) 一般不适用，你的权益主要靠书面协议。
- **地下室**：旺市允许在特定的独立屋、半独立屋和联排屋里设二套房，但必须符合区划、建筑规范 (Ontario Building Code) 和消防规范 (Fire Code)。
- **整栋独立屋**：几个室友一起整租，或者按房间分别出租。

### 几个人一起整租，怎么更划算？

旺市独立屋面积普遍不小，三四个朋友一起整租，平摊下来往往比各自租公寓单间更省。但要提前说好：谁签租约、房间大小不同怎么定价、冬天暖气费和水电网怎么分、有人提前搬走怎么办。最好写成一份简单的室友协议，大家签字各留一份。

## 住旺市还是住多伦多市内？算一笔总账

很多人纠结：同样的钱，是住旺市，还是住北约克、市中心？可以从三方面比较：

1. **房租和空间**：旺市独立屋的房间通常更宽敞，有的还带车位；VMC 新公寓设施新，但价格未必比北约克便宜，要具体比较。
2. **交通成本**：住 VMC 每天坐地铁，交通费和住多伦多差别不大；住 Woodbridge、Kleinburg 这类社区，如果最后还是得买车，保险、油费、停车加起来是一笔不小的开支，要算进总成本。
3. **时间成本**：上下班高峰 400 和 407 一带经常堵车，开车不一定比坐地铁快。按你真实的出门时间，开车和公交各查一遍。

### 刚落地的新移民和留学生

如果你刚到加拿大、还没有本地信用记录，可以准备好录取信或工作合同、资金证明和以前的房东推荐信。在旺市租独立屋单间，不少房东更看重你是否作息规律、爱干净、好沟通，所以和房东见面时坦诚介绍自己的生活习惯，往往比一堆文件更管用。还是那句话：先看房、先签约，再付钱。

## 签约前的检查清单

- [ ] **确认跟谁租**：业主本人、注册经纪还是二房东。有经纪参与的话，到安省地产局 (RECO) 的公开名录查一下。
- [ ] **要书面租约**：安省大多数住宅租赁要使用标准租约 (Ontario standard lease)。
- [ ] **了解押金规定**：受法律保护的租赁，房东可以收最后一个月房租押金和可退的钥匙或门禁卡押金，不能另收"损坏押金"。
- [ ] **地下室看安全**：烟雾和一氧化碳报警器、可以逃生的窗户或门、足够的层高。
- [ ] **公寓要规定**：入住前要一份楼宇规定和搬家流程。
- [ ] **价格太好要警惕**：没看过真实房子、没见到租约之前，不要交任何押金。

在微信群、小红书、51.ca 和约克论坛上，旺市的房源不少，转租帖也多。遇到"人在国外、先转定金再寄钥匙"或者"今天不定明天就没了"的说法，基本可以判定是诈骗。

以上是一般性信息，不构成法律建议。关于租客权益的具体问题，可以咨询房东与租客委员会 (LTB) 或社区法律诊所。

## 常见问题

**旺市VMC公寓值得租吗？**
如果你在约克大学读书，或者每天沿1号线通勤去市中心，VMC 的新公寓楼下就是地铁站，健身房、礼宾等设施也齐全，很方便。代价是周边还在大规模建设，生活氛围不如成熟社区。比较时把停车位、水电费都算进月成本里。

**从旺市去约克大学方便吗？**
很方便。从 Vaughan Metropolitan Centre 站坐1号线往南，经过 Highway 407 和 Pioneer Village 两站，第三站就是 York University 站，不用换乘。住在旺市其他地方，一般先坐 YRT 或 Viva 公交到 VMC 或 Pioneer Village 再换地铁，用 PRESTO 或银行卡付费可以享受一票通免费换乘。

**在旺市没有车能生活吗？**
住在 VMC 和7号公路 Viva 沿线，日常生活基本没问题。Woodbridge、Maple、Kleinburg 等社区更偏向开车生活，公交班次少，签约前一定要用具体地址查公交。

**旺市的地下室出租合法吗？**
旺市允许在部分独立屋、半独立屋和联排屋里设二套房 (secondary suite)，但必须符合区划规定、安省建筑规范和消防规范。看房时问房东地下室有没有按许可建造，并检查报警器和逃生出口。

**旺市有哪些GO火车站？**
Barrie 线上的 Maple 站和 Rutherford 站都在旺市，可以坐火车去 Union 站。不同时段班次差别较大，上班前先查好时刻表。

## 参考资料

- [TTC：Line 1 extension opening（2017年1号线延长线开通）](https://www.ttc.ca/news/2017/December/Line-1-extension-opening-brings-TTC-service-changes-)

# Roommate Moving Out Ontario: Lease, Rent and Deposit

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/blog/roommate-moving-out-early/
Language: English
Updated: 2026-11-21

Roommate moving out in Ontario? What happens to a shared lease, who pays rent when a roommate leaves, how to replace them and what to do with the deposit.

Roommate moving out in Ontario? What happens next depends on one question: is your roommate a **co-tenant on the lease**, or do they **rent a room from you**? A co-tenant's notice generally doesn't end the tenancy for the people who stay, the landlord still expects the full rent, and the cleanest way to bring in someone new is usually an assignment with the landlord's written consent.

This guide goes beyond the basics of giving notice (our [N9 form guide](/blog/ending-a-tenancy-n9/) covers that) and focuses on the messy middle: the person leaving, the people staying, the money and the paperwork.

## Key takeaways

- **Check the lease first.** Whose names are on it decides who owes the landlord what.
- **One co-tenant's N9 usually doesn't end the tenancy** for the roommates who stay.
- **The landlord expects the whole rent.** Remaining co-tenants should keep paying in full and sort out the shortfall separately.
- **Swap roommates through an assignment** or a new lease, with written landlord consent.
- **The deposit normally stays with the landlord** until the tenancy ends; the departing roommate's share is settled between roommates.
- **Roommate disputes over money** usually go to Small Claims Court, not the Landlord and Tenant Board (LTB).

*This is general information, not legal advice. For your situation, contact the [Landlord and Tenant Board](https://tribunalsontario.ca/ltb/) or a community legal clinic.*

## Roommate moving out in Ontario: which kind of roommate is it?

| | Co-tenant (both on the lease) | Roommate renting from the head tenant |
|---|---|---|
| Who has an agreement with the landlord? | Everyone on the lease | Only the head tenant |
| Who owes the landlord rent? | Usually all co-tenants, for the full amount | The head tenant |
| How does the roommate give notice? | N9 to the landlord, and a heads-up to roommates | Whatever your house agreement says |
| Who approves a replacement? | The landlord | Usually the head tenant (subject to the lease and landlord's rules) |
| Where do money disputes go? | Landlord issues: LTB. Roommate vs roommate: Small Claims Court | Small Claims Court |

The LTB's Interpretation Guideline 21 notes that the Residential Tenancies Act (RTA) doesn't define "roommate." Someone who lives in the unit but isn't a tenant is often treated as an **occupant**, with no agreement with the landlord, even if they pay rent to the head tenant. The facts matter, so if your setup is unusual, get advice.

## Co-tenant leaving the lease: what actually happens

When a co-tenant wants out, they'll often hand the landlord an N9. The LTB's own brochure says that in a joint tenancy, if the other tenants don't sign the notice, the tenancy continues for them. In practice:

- **The people staying keep their home.** The landlord can't treat one roommate's N9 as an eviction of everyone else.
- **The person leaving may not be off the hook.** Unless the landlord agrees to release them, or someone properly takes over their spot, they may still be responsible for rent under the lease.
- **Nothing changes on paper by itself.** The lease still lists the original names until the landlord signs something new.

### If everyone wants to leave

Then all co-tenants sign one N9, with the usual 60 days' notice and a date at the end of a rental period. Mixed plans ("two of us stay, one goes") are where assignment comes in.

## Replacing a roommate: the clean way

### Option 1: assignment

An assignment transfers a tenant's place in the lease to a new person, who takes over the rights and obligations. Under RTA section 95, a tenant needs the landlord's consent to assign. The landlord can:

- **consent** to the assignment,
- **refuse assignment in general**, or
- **agree in principle but refuse a particular person.** Once they've agreed in principle, they can't arbitrarily or unreasonably refuse a specific person you propose.

If a landlord refuses assignment outright, or doesn't answer a written request within 7 days, the RTA lets the tenant give notice to end the tenancy within 30 days of the request. Think carefully before using that in a shared unit: ending the tenancy can affect everyone who lives there, so talk to your roommates and a legal clinic first.

### Option 2: a new lease with the new group

Some landlords prefer to sign a fresh lease with the staying roommates plus the newcomer. That's fine, but read it closely. A new lease shouldn't quietly change your rent or terms in ways the RTA wouldn't otherwise allow; if something looks off, ask a clinic before signing.

### Option 3: a sublet (only if they're coming back)

If your roommate is leaving for a term and plans to return, a sublet may fit better. They stay responsible to the landlord while someone else lives there. See our guide to [sublets and assignments in Ontario](/blog/sublet-and-assignment-ontario/) for the consent rules.

### Replacement checklist

- [ ] Departing roommate tells everyone in writing, with a move-out date
- [ ] Roommates agree on who looks for the replacement, and how candidates are approved
- [ ] Written request to the landlord to assign (or to sign a new lease), with the candidate's details
- [ ] Landlord's consent in writing, naming the new person
- [ ] Deposit share, keys, fobs and utilities handed over, with receipts
- [ ] New person reads and signs your house agreement

## Who pays rent when a roommate leaves?

From the landlord's point of view, rent is owed for the **unit**, not per bedroom. Most shared leases make co-tenants jointly responsible, so if one share goes missing, the landlord can look to whoever is still there.

The practical rule: **pay the full rent on time, then deal with your old roommate.** A shortfall can lead to an N4 notice for non-payment against the whole household. After that:

1. **Ask in writing** for the missing amount, with dates and your e-transfer history.
2. **Point to your roommate agreement**, if you have one, especially any notice period.
3. **Consider Small Claims Court** if they won't pay. The LTB generally doesn't handle disputes between roommates.

If your roommate rented a room from you, the result is similar: you owe the landlord the whole rent, and your claim against the roommate is a private one.

## What happens to the deposit?

In Ontario, a landlord can collect a rent deposit of no more than one month's rent, and it's applied to the **last month of the tenancy**. When one roommate leaves mid-lease, the tenancy hasn't ended, so the landlord normally keeps holding the deposit. That surprises many people.

The usual fix is a handover between roommates:

- **The incoming roommate pays the departing roommate** their share of the deposit, and both sign a short receipt.
- **Or the remaining roommates** reimburse the departing one and collect from the newcomer later.

Ask the landlord to note the change in writing so everyone knows whose money the deposit now represents. Our guide to [last month's rent deposit rules](/blog/rent-deposit-rules-ontario/) covers interest and how the deposit is applied.

## When the departing roommate was the head tenant

This is the trickiest case. If the only person on the lease leaves and the roommates were occupants, Guideline 21 says occupants generally must leave when the tenancy ends. Before the head tenant moves out, ask the landlord whether the remaining roommates can take over through an assignment or a new lease, and get the answer in writing. Don't wait until move-out week.

## Prevent the next headache

Most of these fights come down to things nobody wrote down. A short [roommate agreement](/blog/roommate-agreement-ontario/) that sets a notice period between roommates (30 days is common), who finds the replacement and how the deposit share is handled will save you weeks of stress.

## Find your next roommate

## FAQ

**Can my roommate just leave in the middle of the lease?**
They can physically move out, but if they're a co-tenant on the lease, walking away doesn't end their obligations by itself. The tenancy usually continues for whoever stays, and the person who left may still be responsible for rent until the landlord releases them or a replacement properly takes over their place.

**Do I have to pay my roommate's share of the rent after they move out?**
If you're both tenants on the same lease, your landlord will usually expect the full rent for the unit, no matter who paid what. Paying the full amount on time protects your tenancy. You can then try to recover the missing share from your former roommate, which is a separate dispute between you two.

**Does the landlord have to accept the replacement roommate I find?**
Swapping a roommate on the lease needs the landlord's consent. Under section 95 of the Residential Tenancies Act, once a landlord agrees to assignment in principle, they can't arbitrarily or unreasonably refuse a specific person you propose. A refusal based on a real concern, such as a poor rental history, may be reasonable.

**Can I sue my old roommate for unpaid rent at the Landlord and Tenant Board?**
Generally no. The LTB deals with disputes between landlords and tenants, not between roommates. Money claims between roommates usually go to Small Claims Court, so keep e-transfer records, messages and your written roommate agreement.

**What if my roommate rents a room from me and isn't on the lease?**
Then your landlord has no agreement with them; the arrangement is between the two of you. Your house agreement sets the notice they owe you, and you remain responsible to the landlord for the whole rent. If they leave without notice, you'd generally pursue them in Small Claims Court, not at the LTB.

## Sources

- [LTB Brochure: How a Tenant Can End Their Tenancy](https://tribunalsontario.ca/documents/ltb/Brochures/How%20a%20Tenant%20Can%20End%20Their%20Tenancy%20(EN).html)
- [LTB Interpretation Guideline 21: Landlords, Tenants, Occupants and Residential Tenancies](https://tribunalsontario.ca/documents/ltb/Interpretation%20Guidelines/21%20-%20Landlords%20Tenants%20Occupants%20and%20Residential%20Tenancies.html)
- [Residential Tenancies Act, 2006 (sections 95 and 97)](https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/06r17)
- [Steps to Justice: Assign to a new tenant](https://stepstojustice.ca/steps/housing-law/assign-new-tenant/)
- [ACTO: Renting with roommates in Ontario](https://www.acto.ca/for-tenants/renting-with-roommates-in-ontario-heres-the-rights-and-regulations-you-should-know/)

# 室友提前搬走怎么办？安省租约、房租与押金

URL: https://www.colivease.ca/zh/blog/roommate-moving-out-early/
Language: Chinese (Simplified)
Updated: 2026-11-21

室友提前搬走怎么办？先看租约上有谁的名字。本文讲清安省合租时室友走了房租谁付、怎样合法换室友（转让）、押金怎么处理，以及找新室友时如何防骗。

室友提前搬走怎么办？第一步不是吵架，而是翻出租约，看上面写了谁的名字。如果室友和你同在一份租约上，他一个人交N9通常不会让整份租约结束，房东仍然会要求整套房的房租照付；最干净的换人方式，是在房东书面同意下做租约转让（assignment）。

在多伦多合租，"室友突然说下个月要搬走"几乎是每个人都会遇到的事：有人毕业回国，有人找到下城的工作，有人搬去和男朋友住。下面把这件事拆开讲：谁该付钱、怎么换人、押金怎么算。至于N9通知的填写和60天的算法，可以先看我们的[安省退租 N9 指南](/zh/blog/ending-a-tenancy-n9/)。

## 要点速览

- **先看租约**：租约上有谁的名字，决定了谁对房东负什么责任。
- **一个室友交N9，一般不会结束其他人的租约**，留下的人可以继续住。
- **房东收的是整套房的房租**，室友走了，留下的人最好先付清全额再说。
- **换室友走正规流程**：转让或者和房东重签租约，都要房东书面同意。
- **押金通常一直在房东手里**，直到整份租约结束；搬走室友的那份由室友之间结算。
- **室友之间的欠款**一般去小额钱债法庭，而不是房东租客委员会（LTB）。

*本文为一般信息，不构成法律意见。具体情况请咨询房东租客委员会（Landlord and Tenant Board, LTB）或社区法律诊所（community legal clinic）。*

## 室友提前搬走怎么办：先分清是哪种室友

华人合租圈里常见两种情况，处理方式完全不同：

| | 联名租客（大家都在租约上） | 向二房东租房间的室友 |
|---|---|---|
| 谁和房东有合同 | 租约上的每个人 | 只有二房东（head tenant） |
| 谁欠房东房租 | 通常所有联名租客对全额负责 | 二房东 |
| 室友怎么通知搬走 | 给房东交N9，同时告诉室友 | 按你们的室友协议 |
| 谁批准新室友 | 房东 | 一般是二房东（但要遵守租约和房东的规定） |
| 钱的纠纷去哪 | 和房东的纠纷去LTB，室友之间去小额钱债法庭 | 小额钱债法庭 |

LTB第21号解释指引（Interpretation Guideline 21）提到，住宅租赁法（Residential Tenancies Act, RTA）里并没有"室友"这个定义。住在房子里但不是租客的人，往往被视为"居住者"（occupant），和房东没有合同关系，哪怕他每个月把房租转给二房东。具体怎么认定要看事实，情况特殊的话最好先问清楚。

## 联名租客退租：实际会发生什么

室友想走，通常会给房东交一份N9。LTB的官方小册子写得很明白：联名租约里，其他租客没有在通知上签字的，租约对他们继续有效。落到实处就是：

- **留下的人不会被一起赶走**，房东不能把一个人的N9当成全体搬走。
- **搬走的人不一定就没责任了**：除非房东同意让他退出，或者有人正式接替他的位置，否则按照租约他可能仍要对房租负责。
- **纸面上什么都不会自动改变**：在房东签新文件之前，租约上还是原来那几个名字。

如果大家都要搬走，那就所有联名租客在同一份N9上签字，提前60天，退租日期落在一个租期的最后一天。

## 换室友的正确做法

### 方法一：租约转让（assignment）

转让就是把一个租客在租约中的位置交给新的人，由新人接过权利和义务。根据RTA第95条，租客转让需要房东同意，房东可以：

- **同意**这次转让；
- **一概拒绝**转让；
- **原则上同意，但拒绝某个具体人选**。原则上同意之后，就不能任意或不合理地拒绝你们提出的具体人选。

如果房东一概拒绝，或者收到书面请求后7天内不回复，RTA允许租客在提出请求后30天内发出终止租约的通知。但在合租房里用这一条要非常小心：终止的是整份租约，会影响所有住在这里的人，动手之前先和室友商量，再问问法律诊所。

### 方法二：和房东重签一份新租约

有些房东更喜欢直接和留下的人加上新室友签一份新约。这没问题，但要仔细看：新租约不应该借机把房租或条款改成RTA本来不允许的样子，看不懂的地方签字前先问。

### 方法三：转租（只适用于他还会回来）

如果室友只是暑假回国或者去外地实习，之后还要回来，转租（sublet）可能更合适：他仍对房东负责，期间由别人住。详细规则见[安省转租规定](/zh/blog/sublet-and-assignment-ontario/)。

### 换室友清单

- [ ] 搬走的室友书面通知大家，写明搬走日期
- [ ] 室友们商量好谁负责找人、新人怎么面试和拍板
- [ ] 书面向房东申请转让（或重签租约），附上新人的资料
- [ ] 拿到房东写明新人名字的书面同意
- [ ] 押金份额、钥匙、门禁卡、水电网账户交接，并互留收据
- [ ] 新室友阅读并签署你们的室友协议

## 室友走了房租谁付？

在房东眼里，房租是整套房子的，不是按房间收的。大多数合租租约让联名租客共同负责，所以少了谁那一份，房东可以找还住在这里的人要。

最实际的做法：**先按时付清全额，再去找老室友算账。**房租不够，房东可能对全屋发出欠租通知（N4）。之后可以：

1. **书面向室友追讨**，写清金额、日期，附上转账记录；
2. **拿出室友协议**，尤其是里面约定的通知期；
3. **对方拒不还钱，可以考虑小额钱债法庭**。LTB一般不处理室友之间的纠纷。

如果室友是向你（二房东）租的房间，结果也差不多：你要向房东付全额房租，向室友追讨是你们之间的私事。

## 押金怎么办？

在安省，房东最多只能收相当于一个月房租的租金押金（rent deposit），而且这笔钱要用来抵**整份租约的最后一个月**。室友中途搬走时，租约并没有结束，所以房东通常会继续拿着押金，这一点很多人没想到。

常见的解决方法是室友之间交接：

- **新室友把押金份额直接付给搬走的室友**，双方签一张简单收据；
- **或者由留下的室友先垫付**，之后再向新室友收。

最好请房东书面确认一下变更，免得以后说不清押金是谁的钱。押金利息和抵扣方式见[安省租房押金规定](/zh/blog/rent-deposit-rules-ontario/)。

## 搬走的是二房东，怎么办？

这是最棘手的情况。如果租约上唯一的租客要走，而其他人只是居住者，按照第21号指引，租约结束时居住者一般也要搬走。所以二房东决定搬走之前，就要去问房东：剩下的人能不能通过转让或重签新约接手？拿到书面答复再安心，别等到搬家前一周才发现。

## 找新室友时小心骗局

很多人换室友会在微信群、小红书、51.ca、约克论坛发帖，这些地方人多、来得快，但也是骗子活跃的地方。几条底线：

- 没见过面、没核实身份前，不要先转"定金"；
- 对方说"人在国外，先打钱我再寄钥匙"，基本可以判定是骗局；
- 用聊天记录和书面协议留下证据，押金交接一定写收据。

## 让下一次换室友更顺利

大多数室友纠纷，都源于当初没有写下来的事情。一份简单的室友协议，写明室友之间的通知期（常见是30天）、谁负责找接替的人、押金份额怎么交接，就能省下好几周的麻烦。

## 常见问题

**室友提前搬走，我要替他付房租吗？**
如果你们都是同一份租约上的租客（co-tenants），房东通常会要求整套房子的房租照常付清，不管原来谁付多少。先按时付清全额，保住大家的租约，再去找搬走的室友追讨他那一份。

**室友交了N9，整份租约就结束了吗？**
一般不会。LTB的官方说明指出，联名租约中其他租客没有在N9上签字的，租约对他们继续有效。留下的人可以继续住，但搬走的人在房东同意解除或有人正式接替之前，可能仍要对房租负责。

**房东必须接受我们找来的新室友吗？**
换人上租约需要房东同意。根据RTA第95条，房东一旦原则上同意转让（assignment），就不能任意或不合理地拒绝你们提出的具体人选。如果拒绝是基于真实的顾虑，比如对方租房记录很差，可能属于合理。

**室友欠我房租不还，可以去LTB告他吗？**
一般不行。LTB处理的是房东和租客之间的纠纷，不处理室友之间的钱。室友之间的欠款通常要去小额钱债法庭（Small Claims Court），所以转账记录、聊天记录和室友协议都要保存好。

**我是二房东，室友找我租的房间，他走了怎么办？**
这种情况下房东和你的室友之间没有合同，安排只在你们两人之间。通知期以你们的室友协议为准，而你作为租约上的租客，仍要向房东付全额房租。对方不辞而别的话，一般只能去小额钱债法庭追讨。

## 参考资料

- [LTB Brochure: How a Tenant Can End Their Tenancy](https://tribunalsontario.ca/documents/ltb/Brochures/How%20a%20Tenant%20Can%20End%20Their%20Tenancy%20(EN).html)
- [LTB Interpretation Guideline 21](https://tribunalsontario.ca/documents/ltb/Interpretation%20Guidelines/21%20-%20Landlords%20Tenants%20Occupants%20and%20Residential%20Tenancies.html)
- [Residential Tenancies Act, 2006（第95、97条）](https://www.ontario.ca/laws/statute/06r17)
- [Steps to Justice: Assign to a new tenant](https://stepstojustice.ca/steps/housing-law/assign-new-tenant/)
- [ACTO: Renting with roommates in Ontario](https://www.acto.ca/for-tenants/renting-with-roommates-in-ontario-heres-the-rights-and-regulations-you-should-know/)
